class_sf.label: Nominal class SF (detected vs GT SF)

class_bw.label: Nominal class BW (detected vs GT BW)

measured_bw.label: Measured BW (box estimate vs GT BW)

class_bw within tol & sf wrong.label: Detected BW within 10% of GT BW but detected SF wrong
class_bw within tol & sf wrong.condition: abs(col('Detected BW (Hz)') - col('GT BW (Hz)')) / col('GT BW (Hz)') <= 0.10 and col('Detected SF') != col('GT SF')

class_bw & sf ok, measured_bw off.label: Detected BW and SF correct but measured BW off GT BW (beyond 10%)
class_bw & sf ok, measured_bw off.condition: abs(col('Detected BW (Hz)') - col('GT BW (Hz)')) / col('GT BW (Hz)') <= 0.10 and col('Detected SF') == col('GT SF') and abs(col('Measured BW (Hz)') - col('GT BW (Hz)')) / col('GT BW (Hz)') > 0.10

class_bw & sf ok & measured_bw ok.label: Detected BW and SF correct and measured BW near GT BW
class_bw & sf ok & measured_bw ok.condition: abs(col('Detected BW (Hz)') - col('GT BW (Hz)')) / col('GT BW (Hz)') <= 0.10 and col('Detected SF') == col('GT SF') and abs(col('Measured BW (Hz)') - col('GT BW (Hz)')) / col('GT BW (Hz)') <= 0.10
